name: Classic dart
summary: The one everyone learns first. Fast, straight and forgiving.

steps.title: Crease the middle
steps.text: Fold the sheet in half the long way, press a sharp crease, then open it flat again.

steps.title: Fold the top corners in
steps.text: Bring each top corner down to the center crease.

steps.title: Fold the edges in again
steps.text: Fold each slanted edge to the center crease. Keep the point sharp.

steps.title: Fold in half
steps.text: Fold the left half over onto the right, along the center crease.

steps.title: Fold the first wing
steps.text: Fold the top layer over so its long edge meets the folded edge.

steps.title: Turn it over
steps.text: Flip the plane so the other side faces up.

steps.title: Fold the second wing
steps.text: Same fold on this side: long edge to the folded edge.

steps.title: Open the wings
steps.text: Lift both wings until they sit level, angled slightly up.

done.title: Ready to fly
done.text: Hold the body just behind the nose and throw gently, straight ahead.
